title: 2DTreasure
body:
# 2DTreasure - 2D Treasure Hunt

> ⚠️ **ALPHA VERSION** - This plugin is in development. Bugs may exist.

A Terraria-style 2D treasure hunt minigame!

## Features

- **2D Terrain Generation** - Fixed Z-axis world
- **Map Preview Phase** - Spectate from above to find chest
- **Ore Generation** - Diamond, Gold, Iron, Copper, Coal
- **Animal Spawning** - Terraria-style surface animals
- **Sign System** - Click to join/leave
- **Auto Reset** - Return to lobby after game

## Game Flow

1. Join via sign click
2. Admin starts: `/2dtreasure start`
3. **Map Preview (20 sec)** - Find the chest location
4. Game Start - Spawn with iron pickaxe
5. Dig to find the treasure chest!
6. First to open wins (64 diamonds)
7. Auto return to lobby

## Terrain

| Layer | Material |
|-------|----------|
| Surface | Grass + Saplings |
| Upper | Dirt |
| Middle | Stone + Ores |
| Bottom | Bedrock |

| Ore | Chance |
|-----|--------|
| Diamond | 3% |
| Gold | 5% |
| Iron | 7% |
| Copper | 7% |
| Coal | 8% |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/2dtreasure setup spawn` | Set spawn |
| `/2dtreasure setup lobby` | Set lobby |
| `/2dtreasure setup area pos1/pos2` | Set area |
| `/2dtreasure start` | Start game |
| `/2dtreasure stop` | Force stop |

**Aliases:** `/2dt`, `/treasure2d`

## Signs
```
Join: [2DT] lobby
Leave: [2DT] leave
```

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `twodtreasure.admin` | Admin | op |
| `twodtreasure.play` | Play | true |

## Requirements

- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+
- No dependencies
